name: Bomber
description: General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+) You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Far Lobber.description: When you use the Attack action to throw a vial or flask, you can target an object or creature you can see within 40 feet of yourself.

Long Shots.description: Attacking at long range doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Thrown weapons.
